_: Data for the 'premieres on X' signal (OS-T-3HXMY). One entry per service, ids and names as the import stores them from TMDB watch/providers. 'notes': exact (case-insensitive) text of a German release_dates type 4 note that names the service. 'companies': production companies that only ever mean this service; a title whose studios name a different service than its note stays unknown.
